proposed.sourceName: Halal Monitoring Committee (HMC) — Criteria for Halal
proposed.paraphrase: HMC certifies as halal only meat and animal derivatives from animals hand-slaughtered by a Muslim with the Tasmiyah recited and verified through the supply chain; where the animal source of gelatin is unverified, the zabiha condition cannot be confirmed and the gelatin is not accepted as halal.

proposed.sourceName: Heliyon — Towards halal pharmaceutical: Exploring alternatives to animal-based ingredients (Herdiana et al.)
proposed.paraphrase: Peer-reviewed review noting gelatin is predominantly sourced from pig and bovine tissue and that halal certification is essential to establish a permissible source; absent verified halal-slaughter provenance, gelatin of unspecified origin cannot be treated as halal.

researcherNote: Zabiha position (HMC/HFSAA). Under the strictest position, unverified animal origin cannot satisfy the zabiha condition, supporting seeded draft grade 5 (Haram). Two independent sources (HMC standard body + Heliyon peer-reviewed). APPROVED by owner 2026-06-28.
